text:
Gold Price in 2020
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2020, the LBMA gold price rose 19.2% between 2020-01-31 ($1,584) and 2020-12-30 ($1,888). The highest sampled price was $1,965 in July and the lowest was $1,584 in January. The mean of these observations was $1,779. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2020:
COVID-19 and unprecedented monetary stimulus pushed gold above $2,000 per ounce for the first time.
